{"notes": "VISIT 4 (8:30): Picture still shows the full fish, all dark and connected to START. Nose start, both strokes crossing at the tail neck (~x23, y10), and the lower join extras (~x18-19, y13-14) are still connected and harmless. No hand labels visible, so I still can't say who built what. I'm crediting outcomes, not individuals.

Maya: At 8:00 she repeated 'fish looks good, hands off, let it run.' Consistent with 6:15 and accurate against the picture. Solid leadership and discipline, plus the clear 1:15 replan. Still unseen doing hands-on work; haven't confirmed the replan reached Priya. Ask both, and what she'd do differently.

Tom: At 8:00 he said 'looks good, hands off and let it fall.' Accurate, and it backs Maya's call, so good collaboration and discipline. But he's echoing rather than adding anything new. Still unknown whether he cleared the old tail.

Priya: Not seen since visit 1 (pad showed old start). Silent again this visit. No evidence either way. Ask whether it was fixed and what she contributed. Don't penalize her for absence from my visits alone.

Leo: Not seen or heard this visit. Earlier: accurate check of the lower join and crossing, honest about the flaw, called a hands-off rule at the crossing. Still unclear what he physically built.

Review: ask all four privately who built what, who cleared the old tail, and what the replan cost. Don't rate on the final picture alone, since it can't separate individual contributions. Wait to see the push result before finalizing."}
